payout_quote: Clerks: $285 ($255 for Election Day assignment; $30 for two hours of training). Assistant Supervisor: $350 plus mileage ($260 for Election Day assignment; $90 for six hours of training). Supervisors: $390 plus mileage ($300 for Election Day assignment; $90 for six hours of training). Bilingual Poll Workers: $20 additional payment. Election Hours: report November 3, 2026 at 6:00 a.m. and work the entirety of the Election Day, approximately until 9:30 p.m.
steps: Be at least 18 and a registered voter in California; read, write and understand English.
Complete the Poll Worker Application and submit it to pollworkers@rov.sbcounty.gov (email/mail per official instructions).
Attend the mandatory training session (2 hours for clerks, 6 hours for supervisors — included in the stipend).
Work Election Day November 3, 2026, 6:00 a.m. to approximately 9:30 p.m. (refusal to complete the assignment forfeits all payments).
catches: Election-day only work, not steady employment.
Very long day: 6:00 a.m. to approximately 9:30 p.m. (~15.5 hours).
Mandatory training required; failing to complete the Election Day assignment forfeits all payments including training.
Must be a California registered voter and read/write/understand English.
Pay timing not stated on the official page.
biggest_catch: One ~15.5-hour Election Day per election — not steady work; refusing or failing to complete the assignment forfeits all pay including training.
eligibility: 18+, registered voter in California, reads/writes/understands English, has transportation, mandatory 2-hour training.
